title: Samastha Keralam P.O
desc: Prabhakaran, a dedicated Gandhian panchayat member, strives tirelessly for his village's welfare, only to face severe danger after exposing the misdeeds of powerful, corrupt politicians.

title: Oru Muthassikkadha
desc: Fishermen's peaceful lives shatter when a stranger's business ambitions arrive.

title: Pathamudayam
desc: B. G. Menon recruits Vikrman, a criminal and the lookalike of Jayamohan, an honest cop who was killed by Lion C. Menon's men, to nab him.

title: Kilukil Pamparam
desc: Anantha lands a gig as a palace caretaker for the government. With a dispute brewing over the assets, he's tasked with keeping the property safe and secure.

title: Avidathe Pole Ivideyum
desc: Anirudhan, a villager, marries his friend's sister, who lives in the city, while his friend marries Anirudhan's sister. However, the couples face problems due to the difference in their lifestyles.

title: Kallanum Polisum
desc: Prabhakaran, who is from a middle-class family, gets a job in the police department. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with a thief's sister.

title: Pakal
desc: Nandakumar, a reporter, is assigned to cover the hapless plight of farmers at Pannakamkudi. Upon seeing their sufferings, he decides to help them.

title: Alanchery Thambrakkal
desc: Two brothers, Chathukutty and Chandappan, lead a happy life with their families. However, problems start brewing in the lives of Chathukutty and Chandappan when a tenant moves into their house.

title: Gayathridevi Ente Amma
desc: Appu's father lies to him that his mother is dead. Devoid of a mother's love, Appu resorts to smoking and drinking until he learns that she is still alive.

title: Chamayam
desc: Esthappan and Anto are two fishermen who do not get along well. However, when Esthappan learns that Anto sings and dances well, he requests him to perform in his stage plays.

title: Pulliman
desc: Orphan Kunjunni and statue vendor Radha face familial opposition to their romance. Their love is tested as Radha's father disapproves of their relationship.

title: Appu
desc: Appukuttan is an honest young man who falls in love with Sarojini. But she does not like him. One day, Sarojini is found raped and murdered! Who killed her?

title: 7th Day
desc: A suspended crime branch officer gets involved with a group of friends who are caught in a problematic situation and are being followed by a local goon.

title: Vellathooval
desc: Jiya, a fun-loving girl, is tired of her conservative family and therefore decides to abscond with her friend Manu. They become good friends but the society misunderstands them.

title: Unnikrishnante Adyathe Christmas
desc: Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.

title: Indrajith
desc: Join Indrajith on an adventurous trip to the lush forests of northeastern India as he embarks on a quest to discover a coveted precious stone. Excitement awaits!

title: Vinayapoorvam Vidyadharan
desc: Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.

title: Parvathy Parinayam
desc: What happens to Siva and his one-sided love for Parvathy who does not reciprocate his love?
